title: Warm Italian Cheddar Cheese Panettone
description: A malty and comforting Italian dessert featuring a rich cheddar cheese flavor, created in the form of a panettone. This dessert is perfect for any occasion.
instructions: Combine flour, sugar, and yeast in a large mixing bowl.
In a separate bowl, whisk together warm milk and eggs.
Slowly add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients, mixing until a smooth batter forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with plastic wrap, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Punch down the dough and shape it into a panettone mold.
Let it rise again for another 30 minutes.
Bake the panettone for 25 minutes, or until it's golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let it cool on a wire rack.
Serve warm, topped with melted butter and cheddar cheese.
You can also toast the panettone and top it with the cheese for a crispy twist.
